name: Plate Svend Press
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and squeeze a weight plate between your palms in front of your chest.
Press your palms forcefully inward against the plate so your chest contracts firmly before you even extend your arms.
While maintaining constant inward pressure, push the plate smoothly straight out in front of your chest until your arms are extended.
Pull the plate slowly back to your chest without relaxing the inward squeeze.
tips: Keep your ribs over your hips as the plate moves away from your chest.
Keep your shoulders pulled down and back rather than rounding forward as your arms extend.
